verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs claim multilingual OCR that 'performs strongly across more than 40 languages' (docs-6). A hands-on community test of a bidirectional English/Hebrew document directly contradicts the right-to-left part of this, reporting the Hebrew output 'had no correspondence to the text whatsoever' (comm-5). Missing for 10: any evidence on CJK scripts, a published list of supported languages or scripts, fidelity benchmarks against English, and independent confirmation that RTL scripts work.
